task:
Goal: Install Inkuno 0.0.1 on this Mac from the GitHub release, launch it, uninstall Bref. Shell work only. No repo edits, no commits.

Context: Release https://github.com/kolisachint/inkuno/releases/tag/v0.0.1, assets: inkuno-macos.dmg (22.4 MB), SHA256SUMS. Old app: target/debug/bref dev binary (PID 81126 possibly running) + any /Applications/Bref.app.

Steps:
1. cd /tmp; curl -LO the dmg + SHA256SUMS from the release (gh release download v0.0.1 --repo kolisachint/inkuno --pattern 'inkuno-macos.dmg' --pattern 'SHA256SUMS' --clobber). Verify: shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS (or grep line). STOP if mismatch.
2. Mount: hdiutil attach inkuno-macos.dmg -nobrowse; copy Inkuno.app to /Applications (cp -R, replacing any existing Inkuno.app; ask nothing).
3. hdiutil detach; launch: open /Applications/Inkuno.app; verify process alive 10s (pgrep -f Inkuno).
4. Uninstall bref: kill PID 81126 if alive (graceful kill, verify gone); if /Applications/Bref.app exists, trash it (rm -rf — confirm path first with ls; ONLY /Applications/Bref.app, never anything else). Leave ~/Library configs + repo target/ binaries alone (say so in report).
5. Report: shasum result; installed version (Inkuno.app path + size); new PID + alive proof; bref removals (PID killed? app trashed?); leftovers noted (dev binaries, configs).

Do NOT delete the repo, worktrees, downloads, or configs. Only the two removals above.
